pairs.question: Priamus quanto pretio sepeliendum Hectorem redemit?
pairs.answer: Rogavit furentem, supplicavit armato vitamque suam exponere maluit, ut cadaveri debita non negaret.
pairs.derivation: Authorial-rhetorical pair within letter XXII section [2]. The interrogative 'quanto pretio... redemit?' (at what price did Priam ransom Hector?) is directly answered by the following sentence naming the price: his entreaties, his supplication, and his willingness to risk his own life. Answer window ends at the first full stop ('non negaret'); the next sentence ('et quoniam in his personis mutua sunt officia pietatis...') turns from answering to drawing the moral lesson, so it is excluded. No scaffolding ([n] markers, numbers) falls inside either span.
